gpu_status: 0 M4 forwards; 2956 calls / 24 batches under the standing GPU authorization
model: kev-4B (runner module f118ea59: identity, source, loader); L11 = Qwen3.5 full attention, 16 query heads x 256 in 4 KV groups, output gate, o_proj without bias

preregistered_analysis.S: key-class arms: S(arm) = #cells where the donor-new-source patch is JOINT and the donor-ROUND-source patch of the same arm is not (target host new). Value swap: S_V = #cells where the swap into host new is JOINT and the swap into host ROUND is not (source donor new)
preregistered_analysis.SPEC: SPEC iff dM_main > dM_round in >= 75% of cells AND in a majority of cells for >= 10 of 14 donor groups
preregistered_analysis.additivity_gate: per capture, the class contributions must sum to the forward's own o_proj input within 1e-3 relative (fail-closed in the runner)
preregistered_analysis.always_reported: S, SPEC, J_main, J_round and median dM per arm; per-capture class contribution norms; leave-one-donor-group-out of the verdict and of the value-swap class; per host; all nulls
preregistered_analysis.class_rules: for C in PARTNER, ROUND_PEERS, OTHER_ITEMS, SELF, CONTEXT, ROUNDVOTES: SUF(C) iff S(only_C) >= 1/2 S(full) and SPEC(only_C); NEC(C) iff S(drop_C) <= 1/2 S(full)
preregistered_analysis.consistency_gate: the full arm is the M3 all-heads patch: its 208 rows must equal M3's bitwise (GPU, checked in the run) and S(full) = 51; otherwise verdict INCONSISTENT_WITH_M3 and no locus claim
preregistered_analysis.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: Every key before the span is identical in a scene's new and ROUND arms, so SPEC of only_PARTNER / only_ROUND_PEERS / only_OTHER_ITEMS / only_CONTEXT comes from the donor's span-side attention and gate, not from round information in those keys. V_STRONG or V_PARTIAL: the host's own attention and gate suffice once given the donor's partner values, so the host deficit is in the partner's value representation, built upstream in host context. V_NONE with PARTNER in B: the donor's partner contribution repairs only with the donor's own span-side attention and gate, so the host's span-side read of the partner is also deficient, although its attention mass is similar (M3). The value swap also moves the donor's partner content (author / block / received differ across scenes), so it is not a pure context-representation swap; same-author cells are reported separately, descriptively
preregistered_analysis.readouts: M = conflict margin; A = logit(reject_conflict) - max(accept, wait); JOINT = M > 0 and A > 0; dM = M(patch) - M(in-run capture of the patched target arm)
preregistered_analysis.units: the 104 cross-group cells of M1-M3; cells share donors and hosts, counts are descriptive decision rules, not independent tests
preregistered_analysis.value_swap: V_STRONG iff S_V >= 1/2 S(full) and SPEC(vswap); V_PARTIAL iff S_V >= 1/4 S(full) and SPEC(vswap); else V_NONE
preregistered_analysis.verdict: B = base classes (not ROUNDVOTES) in SUF u NEC. LOCUS:<B joined by +> if 1 <= |B| <= 2; else LOCUS:ROUNDVOTES if B is empty and ROUNDVOTES in SUF u NEC; else DIFFUSE (B empty, or |B| > 2)
